description: Racks of pikes and crossbows line the walls, alongside a single, suspiciously well-maintained halberd that nobody on the roster remembers issuing.

items.name: a well-oiled halberd
items.description: It's the only weapon in the room that looks like it's ever been cleaned.

items.name: a muttering sword
items.description: A plain blade with a faint, continuous grumble coming from somewhere near the hilt.

items.name: a Watch-issue spear
items.description: Standard issue, by which the Watch means the point is mostly straight. Balanced for throwing, or at least for being thrown.
